# flamelens

flamelens is an interactive flamegraph viewer for the terminal.

Description

flamelens reads folded stacks (stack traces aggregated in the "folded" format) and
renders an interactive flamegraph in a terminal UI so you can explore profiling data
without opening a browser.

Usage

Run flamelens with a folded stacks filename, or pipe folded stacks data to it:

flamelens <folded-stacks-filename>

or

cat folded-stacks.txt | flamelens

Live mode

flamelens can attach to a running process to display a live flamegraph (when supported):

flamelens --pid <pid-of-process>

Viewing perf data

You can generate folded stacks from perf and pipe them to flamelens, for example:

perf script -i perf.data | <tool-to-collapse-perf-output> | flamelens

Key bindings

- h/j/k/l or arrow keys: Navigate cursor for frame selection
- f: Scroll down
- b: Scroll up
- G: Scroll to bottom
- g: Scroll to top
- Enter: Zoom in on the selected frame
- Esc: Reset zoom
- /<regex>: Find and highlight frames matching the regex
- #: Find and highlight frames matching the selected frame
- n: Jump to next match
- N: Jump to previous match
- r: Reset to default view
- z (in Live mode): Freeze the flamegraph
- q (or Ctrl + c): Exit

Examples

- Open a folded stacks file:

  flamelens folded.txt

- Pipe collapsed perf output:

  perf script -i perf.data | inferno-collapse-perf | flamelens

This README intentionally omits build- and implementation-specific details.
